title: Schrag2026Pediatric: pediatric SSVEP-BCI dataset in children and adolescents
description: A pediatric steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface dataset recorded from 47 healthy, BCI-naive children and adolescents aged 5-18 years. Each participant completed a stimulus personalization and comfort-rating pipeline, then played an online four-target SSVEP-controlled navigation game twice, once with a personalized stimulus and once with a standard high-contrast stimulus. Sixteen-channel EEG was recorded at 256 Hz, and events are annotated with HED tags. The data are raw and unpreprocessed. Only 12 trials per session are ground-truth target events; the remaining trial labels are filter-bank CCA classifier outputs rather than ground truth.
methods_description: 16-channel wet Ag/AgCl EEG (g.tec g.USBamp, g.GAMMAcap, 10-20 montage, earlobe reference, Fpz ground) recorded at 256 Hz in a single session of two runs. Stimuli flickered at 6.25, 10, 11.11 and 14.28 Hz in a Unity3D/BCI-Essentials game with online filter-bank CCA classification and visual feedback. Personalization involved 12 stimuli at 10 Hz with pairwise comfort comparisons.
